thread:
Jordan: quick heads-up — proposing a small policy change for fleet admission when GPU pools hit >85% util. idea: prefer short queueing up to 200ms, then soft-degrade (lower model size or reduce tokens) before hard reject. want to run a canary.
Ash: +1. can you outline the rollout plan? metrics to watch?
Jordan: plan: 5% of traffic in region-us-east1 for 24h, then 20% for 48h, then ramp if stable. watch p99 latency, error-rate (4xx), user-visible incompletes, and cost delta. also track GPU active slots and queue length histogram.
Priya: are we sure 200ms is the right queue threshold? that's really tight for some workloads.
Mikey: agree with Priya. a few RLHF endpoints have long KV loads; we should allow per-route overrides. also need to ensure we don't starve long-running batch jobs.
Jordan: per-route override is supported. default threshold 200ms is conservative; can increase to 500ms for known heavy routes. we'll include a per-route flag `admit.policy.queue_threshold_ms`.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: admission-controller v2.3.1 will add `soft_degrade` mode and `queue_threshold_ms` config. See: https://git.redwood/internal/patch/AC-231
Sophia: rough config draft:
```
admit:
  mode: queue_then_degrade
  queue_threshold_ms: 200
  degrade_policy:
    - action: trim_response_tokens
      pct: 25
    - action: switch_model_variant
      to: small-quant
      pct: 10
```
Ash: looks reasonable. need to ensure telemetry sends `admit_reason` tag so we can break down costs and user impact.
Priya: for the canary: split by user_hash to avoid bot-heavy skew. propose exclude admin and infra-test tenants.
Jordan: ack. also we'll add a metric `admit.outcome` with values {queued, degraded, rejected} and `admit.latency_ms` and `gpu_util_at_admit`.
Mikey: alert thresholds? if degraded ratio >2% of traffic or p99 latency regresses >20% then rollback.
Sophia: also create a signpost in console that shows current admit config and recent outcomes per-model.
Jordan: action items:
- Jordan: submit canary rollout PR and infra change (today EOD)
- Priya: set up canary alert dashboards + exclude lists (tomorrow)
- Ash: add telemetry tag and cost breakdown query (tomorrow)
- Mikey: review per-route overrides for batch endpoints (tomorrow)
- Sophia: UI signpost mock (next sprint)
Priya: how do we simulate saturation for the canary safely?
Jordan: we'll run a synthetic load from perf-lab with mix of short chat and long-context gen to push pool to ~88% for short bursts. will coordinate with perf-lab.
perf-lab-bot: loadtest scheduled: perf-lab/roundtrip-20240305-02
Ash: one more nit: make soft_degrade deterministic for debugging (seeded decisions) so we can replay traces.
Jordan: good call. will add a `degrade_seed` field in config.
Sophia: if we see slippage on embedded costs, consider switching degrade action order (variant switch before token trim) — add as param.
Jordan: noted. starting PR now. tagging @Priya @Ash @Mikey for visibility. :rocket: 
Priya: thanks — I'll build the dashboard templates and fake-data panels so we can iterate fast.
Mikey: lgtm. will keep an eye on batch lanes.
Ash: LGTM
Jordan: closing thread once PR merged and canary starts. ping if anything else.
